claims.text: Grand Hyatt Baha Mar is set on Cable Beach and is the most central of the hotels in the Baha Mar complex.

findings.quote: Set on Cable Beach, Grand Hyatt is the most central of the hotels in Baha Mar
findings.note: States both location on Cable Beach and most central hotel.

claims.text: Grand Hyatt was the first hotel to open in the Baha Mar complex.

findings.quote: It was the first hotel to open in the complex and is still currently the largest.
findings.note: Explicitly says first hotel to open.

claims.text: All guest rooms, suites and villas have floor-to-ceiling windows with views of the ocean, the island or the fountain show.

findings.quote: All guest rooms, suites and villas include plush beds and floor-to-ceiling windows with incredible views of the ocean, island, or fountain show.

claims.text: All room categories include balconies, ranging from Juliet balconies to fully furnished ones.

findings.quote: All room categories include balconies—ranging from Juliet balconies to fully furnished ones—with views of the ocean, fountains, or lush grounds.

claims.text: Rooms have Balmain bath amenities.

findings.quote: while Balmain bath amenities add an extra-luxe touch

claims.text: The Reserve's VIP Lounge serves breakfast each morning, light refreshments through the day and hors d'oeuvres in the evening.

findings.quote: VIP Lounge with breakfast each morning, light refreshments throughout the day, and hors d’oeuvres in the evening.

claims.text: Butler service is available with the two-bedroom residences in the East Tower and the two-bedroom poolside villas.

findings.quote: butler service (available with 2-bedroom residences in the East Tower and 2-bedroom poolside villas)

claims.text: Each of the resort's pools has its own distinct Bahamian design, with daybeds, in-pool chaises and cabanas.

findings.quote: Enjoy eight exquisite pools, each with its own distinct Bahamian design and character. During your stay, experience them all, laze on a daybed or an in-pool chaise, or cozy up in a cabana
findings.note: Covers distinct design, daybeds, in-pool chaises and cabanas.

claims.text: ESPA at Baha Mar is a 30,000-square-foot spa.

findings.quote: The ultimate spa experience unfolds with 30,000 square feet of total tranquility with ESPA at Baha Mar.
The 30,000-square-foot Espa offers a striking contrast to the rest of the resort.

claims.text: Royal Blue at Baha Mar is a Jack Nicklaus Signature Golf Course, with ocean vistas on the front nine and forested panoramas on the back nine.

findings.quote: Royal Blue at Baha Mar is a Jack Nicklaus Signature Golf Course
features dramatic vistas of the turquoise ocean on the front nine and forested panoramas on the second half.
findings.note: Ocean front nine, forested back nine.

claims.text: Baha Mar Casino has 100,000 square feet of gaming and live entertainment.

findings.quote: Baha Mar Casino features 100,000 square feet of world-class gaming excitement and live entertainment.

claims.text: Chef Marcus Samuelsson's Marcus at Baha Mar Fish + Chop House is on the beachfront near the pier.

findings.quote: Chef Marcus Samuelsson has brought his signature style and cuisine to Marcus at Baha Mar Fish + Chop House.
Location: Grand Hyatt Baha Mar - Beachfront near the Pier

claims.text: The Reserve is a hotel-within-a-hotel on the top floors of the East Tower, with a private VIP entrance.

findings.quote: The Reserve, which offers a quieter, hotel-within-a-hotel experience that occupies the top floors of the East Tower and features a private VIP entrance

claims.text: Flamingos, sea turtles and tropical birds are part of the resort's wildlife experiences, and there is a daily flamingo parade.

findings.quote: flamingos, sea turtles, and tropical birds are woven into the resort in a way that feels interactive rather than staged, and the daily flamingo parade is a highlight

claims.text: Baha Mar resort guests have unlimited access to Baha Bay waterpark, set directly adjacent on 15 beachfront acres.

findings.quote: The luxe waterpark is directly adjacent to Baha Mar and set on 15 lush beachfront acres
Baha Mar resort guests enjoy exclusive and unlimited access to Baha Bay waterpark.

claims.text: The ESPA spa is perched above the beach.

findings.quote: Perched above the beach, it feels intentionally removed from the buzz.

claims.text: The Chairman Suite has four bedrooms and a private pool overlooking ocean and island views.

findings.quote: the exclusive Chairman Suite boasts four bedrooms, five bathrooms and a private pool overlooking panoramic ocean and island views

claims.text: This is a large resort and is less intimate than smaller hotels.

findings.quote: Service is efficient, with the infrastructure to support a resort of this scale.
While less intimate than smaller hotels, it runs smoothly and reliably.

claims.text: Dining and spa reservations should be planned ahead because prime slots fill quickly.

findings.quote: Plan ahead—especially for dining and spa reservations—as the resort’s size and popularity mean prime slots fill quickly.

claims.text: The resort is about five miles from downtown Nassau.

findings.quote: about seven miles from the airport and five miles from downtown Nassau
